_doc: M2 district fragment template (Master v02 redo). One file per district: m2_frag_<crop_key>.json, plus one world fragment m2_frag_whole.json (fragment_kind 'world'). Copy this file, keep every top-level key, delete the example records you do not use, never leave placeholder values. Coordinates are metres in the M2 frame (m2_frame.json): x east, y north, origin = bottom-left of the land bbox; convert crop pixels with crops[<key>].crop_px_to_m. Round to 0.1 m. Polygons: counter-clockwise, not closed, >=3 points. Polylines in travel order; shared junctions must use identical coordinates. Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are ignored by the merger. The merger maps each layer onto the v14 container named in its '_v14' note, so downstream tools (map_dressing, Look flattener, greybox flatten_plan, crowd, police bake) keep reading the v14 schema 2.0.

district_registry_proposal._doc: Lead proposal, not final: keep the v14 district ids so downstream tools and gameplay keep working; Russian label = name_ru + ' (' + master English name + ')'.

id_convention._doc: Ids are unique across all fragments: <layer prefix><district number>_<seq or NAME>. Gameplay point ids (B01-B06, P01-P16, P09-2 ...) are never renamed and are assigned only in the mapping step.
id_convention.label: LB04_01

district._v14: districts[] : id, name_ru, color, polygon_m, parent_id, notes_ru (area_m2, building_count, share_percent are derived by the merger)
district._doc: Organic envelope of the district as drawn by the master (its built area plus its own green), not a hard border. Neighbouring envelopes must not overlap; common landscape between districts stays outside every envelope. No fence on this outline.

roads._v14: roads[] (vehicle graph). Required: id, class, width_m, lanes, district_ids, polyline_m. Optional: joins_road_ids, access_only, parent_road_id, note_ru. length_m and road_graph are derived.
roads._classes: asphalt road -> highway 7 m / 2 lanes, town_street 6 m / 2 lanes, alley 4.5 m / 1 lane; dirt road or track -> rural_road 3.8 m / 1 lane, dirt_shortcut 3.5 m / 1 lane. Width comes from the class, never from pixels. lanes <= 2 always.

paths._v14: paths[] (walk-only graph). Required: id, class, width_m, polyline_m, district_id, district_ids, walkable true, van_access false.
paths._classes: footpath / promenade -> passage 2.5 m, foot_lane 3 m (arches, lanes between blocks), trail 2 m (forest, hills). A wide promenade is a functional_site polygon (type promenade) plus a passage centreline.

building_masses._v14: building_masses[] (generic buildings). Required: id, district_id, kind, center_m, width_m, depth_m, rotation_deg, floors, polygon_m. Optional: entrance_m, access_road_id, role, block.
building_masses._kinds: rural_house, rural_outbuilding, small_house, midrise, panel, tower; new for the master (lead to confirm): garage_row, shed, kiosk_stall, warehouse, generic. Unknown -> generic + a question.
building_masses._floors: the master is 2D: floors are an estimate (rural 1-2, small_house 2-3, midrise 5-7, panel 5-9, tower 18-22, garage/warehouse 1); set floors_source 'estimate' unless a key text says otherwise.

functional_buildings._v14: functional_buildings[] (named buildings: bases, POI, shops, police, mansions...). Required: id, type, district_id, label_ru, group, center_m, width_m, depth_m, footprint_m, storeys, rotation_deg, entrance_m, access_road_id. Optional: poi_id (filled in the mapping step), color, icon.
functional_buildings._types: use v14 types where they fit (wagon_base, grandpa_house, hut, garage_base, house_base, industrial_complex, prestige_base, police_station, bank, cafe, supermarket, hospital, church, mansion, warehouse, depot, ...). A building that carries a master object key or player-base badge goes here, not in building_masses.

functional_sites._v14: functional_sites[] : id, type, district_id, polygon_m | polyline_m | position_m, label_ru; optional building_id, capacity_vans, surface, diameter_m.
functional_sites._types: square, yard, sidewalk, parking, turnaround, pitch (football), playground, fountain (position_m + diameter_m), promenade, quay, pier (polygon on the sea), garage_yard, port_yard, churchyard, pool (elite pools: water=false, surface 'pool').

plots._v14: plots[] : id, kind (front_yard, farmstead, elite_garden, villa_yard, garden), district_id, polygon_m; optional building_id.

microdistricts._v14: microdistricts[] (courtyard groups of panel blocks): id, center_m, angle, yard_polygon_m, building_ids, arrangement, opening_direction, shared_courtyard. Mostly 04.

water._v14: water[] : id, kind, name_ru, polygon_m and center_m (lakes, ponds) OR centerline_m and width_m (river, canal, stream); district_id or null for shared water. The sea, the main river and the bay belong to the world fragment.
water._kinds: lake, pond, swamp_pond, mountain_lake, river, stream, concrete_canal, sea

water_crossings._v14: water_crossings[] : id, road_id, water_id, position_m, deck_axis_m (two points across the water), kind (bridge, culvert, footbridge). Every road or path that crosses water needs one.

beaches._v14: beaches[] : id, name_ru, polygon_m, land_edge_m, sea_edge_m, width_m, surface 'sand', access_road_ids, closed_ends_ru. 08 (small beach), 09 (city beach), 07 (elite sand strip on the bay).

crop_fields._v14: crop_fields[] : id, district_id, crop, stripe_count, stripe_direction, polygon_m, label_ru (area_m2 derived). Legend 'Field' (yellow hatch).

vegetation_areas._v14: NEW layer. v14 stored no trees: tree_layers() scattered them inside district polygons. The master draws forest, groves, lawns, parks and gardens explicitly, so record them as areas; orchards map to vegetation_parcels kind 'orchard'.
vegetation_areas._kinds: forest (dense), grove (sparse trees), park, lawn, garden, orchard, hedge_row

tree_points_m._doc: Optional: individually drawn trees as [x, y, crown_radius_m]; only where the master shows single trees that matter (squares, streets).

rocks._v14: forest_features.rocks / bay rocks / rock_scarp parcels. Legend 'Rocks, cliffs, ravines'. Coastal cliffs belong to the world fragment unless they sit inside the district.

fences._v14: vegetation_parcels[] kind 'interdistrict_barrier': id, kind, material, district_id, axis_m (polyline), polygon_m (thin band), height_target_m, blocks_foot, blocks_van, gate_road_ids, barrier_role.
fences._rule: Only perimeters the master draws itself (legend 'Fence, perimeter': elite hill oval, port wall, compound walls). Never on a district border. Every road or path that crosses a fence needs a gate listed in gate_road_ids.
fences._materials: elite_fence, port_wall, barbed_fence, low_wall, canal_railing, rock_scarp, dune_ridge

hills._v14: hills[] : id, center_m, radii_m, polygon_m, height_target_m, district_id, summit_path_id. 07 oval hill; contour lines in the master show the slope.

railway._v14: railway{} : polyline_m, buffer_stop_m, active_trains false (01 only: the wagon B01 on rails at the coast); null elsewhere.

lamps_m._doc: NEW layer from the master legend 'Lamp / grip anchor': positions only, no new mechanic. [x, y].

master_keys._doc: Every key drawn in the crop: object keys ('04-07' = district 04, object 07), player-base badges (black), district number circle. text_read empty + legible false when unreadable (most are at this resolution).

points._v14: points[] : id, canonical_id, name_ru, position_m, district_id, category (base, poi, landmark, atm, meeting, water_access, bin, exit, reference), label_offset_px; extras per id (team_shared, interior, access_reserve_m, door_clearance_target_m ...). Filled ONLY in the mapping step by the lead: tracers leave this list empty.

labels._doc: Scheme labels, Russian; district labels carry the master English name in brackets. Renderer anchors; not gameplay.

marina._doc: 07 only (Fedya: add the v14 elite marina to ELITE HILL). Do not retrace REF_FEDYA_MASTER_v02_marina.png: transplant MAP_PLAN_R01_v14.json 'marina' (pier, t_head, 3 fingers, 10 berths, 3 yachts + 4 motor boats, breakwater with light, walk_axis) by a rigid transform: rotate about v14 root_m [1050.657, 516.736] by (axis_deg_new - (-21.9)) and move the root to root_m_new on the elite coast waterline. Quay road from the elite loop road, van to the quay only.

world_only._doc: Filled only in m2_frag_whole.json (fragment_kind 'world'); district fragments leave these empty.

boundary._v14: boundary{} : polygon_m (playable land), barrier text, barrier_band_m, coast_segments_m [[a, b], ...]
boundary.barrier: mountain ridge (world edge) on the N and W; coast on the S and E

mountain_foot_m._doc: NEW: polyline of the foot of the mountain ridge (world edge), W to NE.

sea._v14: water[] kind 'sea' : polygon_m (>=150 m offshore band), return_rule 'return_to_last_ground_point'

river._v14: water[] kind 'river' : centerline_m from the mountain lake to the sea, width_m; river mouth at the city beach

trunk_roads._doc: Inter-district roads as one set of polylines with the junction points every district fragment must reuse.

exits._v14: exits[] (v14 NW/NE posts P16, P16-2). The master shows no exit posts: leave empty and ask.
